newsitem.title: USA: Frontier sees Q4 shr below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Frontier sees Q4 shr below estimates.

text.p: Frontier Corp said on Tuesday that it expects to report fourth quarter earnings per share from recurring operations in the range of $0.30 to $0.34 in the fourth quarter.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate for Frontier's fourth quarter is $0.40 a share, compared with $0.36 a share the previous fourth quarter.
The company said it expects long distance revenue in the fourth quarter to be in the range of $400 million and below current analysts' expectations.
Frontier said that the quarter will also be hurt by additional selling, general, and administrative costs incurred to better position the company for future growth.
According to the company, long distance revenue in the fourth quarter has been affected by a disappointing response to the company's re-marketing of its "dial-around" service.

It said that long distance revenue has also been hurt by faster than expected migration off the company's network by the company's largest wholesale customer and slower growth of enhanced services with the customer.
A delay in prepaid calling card program distribution and lower customer retention primarily in the wholesale and consumer segments was also cited.

Frontier said it had anticipated that increased revenue from prepaid services would begin to have a positive impact on revenue in the fourth quarter, but it now anticipates that the revenue impact from previously signed contracts will be realized beginning early in 1997.
The company said it is targeting earnings growth from recurring operations to be around 10 percent for 1997.
